sloka: वायुः प्राणः सुखं वायुर्वायुः सर्वमिदं जगत् ।वायुना सम्परित्यक्तं न सुखं विन्दते जगत् ।। ७.३५.६१ ॥
transliteration: vāyuḥ prāṇaḥ sukhaṁ vāyurvāyuḥ sarvamidaṁ jagat ।vāyunā samparityaktaṁ na sukhaṁ vindate jagat ।। 7.35.61 ॥

translations.english: Vayu is the life-breath, Vayu is happiness, and Vayu is this entire world, for the world finds no happiness when completely abandoned by Vayu.
